verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a public REST API and an OAuth+MCP integration for single-item agent actions (list sales, draft or edit a product, publish it). Nothing describes a bulk or batch operation that acts on many items at once. Looping over per-item API or MCP calls is a developer building block, not a bulk-operations capability, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
